objective: Observe firm project commitments, physical readiness, actual use, realized financing/expenditure and portfolio allocation with source-specific limits.

collection_phases.title: Public and documented-access sources first
tasks: Save BAI/selected issuer daily holdings and shares outstanding; same-date NAV must be verified before any net-creation estimate.
SEC submissions and original company/utility/regulatory documents for contract, condition, deposit and named-order events; DART documented-key path for Korean filings.
Epoch facility/timeline/chip CSV versions, keeping modeled estimates labeled and attribution.
EIA860M monthly raw XLSX for planned/operating/cancelled generators; EIA923 or PUDL monthly output after confirming file period.
PJM annual large-load XLS for checked fields; monthly DC peak needs separate PDF extraction until machine-readable source is verified.
FRED IPG3344S/CAPUTLG3344S/A35SUO with a valid registered key; current data access must be tested once, then cache.
OpenRouter public rankings for scoped usage snapshots; official API authenticated retrieval/cost remains pending.

collection_phases.title: Register free access only where it adds needed resolution
tasks: Comtrade free tier for broader monthly reporter/partner/product panels; guest preview proves only small query schema.
USITC DataWeb free account/Login.gov/token for material-form HTS10 panels; renew 6-month token.
Artificial Analysis free key for model efficiency controls; 1000/day limit and attribution.
Census free key optional: use public XLS or FRED when adequate. OpenRouter dataset API cost/free-access confirmation is required before any paid route.

collection_phases.title: Combine matched observations and test signal hypotheses
tasks: Join events by legal entity and verified project/facility/contract IDs.
Preserve raw versions, publish dates, scope, currency/unit, revisions/cancellations and cohort definitions.
Build separate demand commitment, actual spending, physical realization/usage and ETF allocation views.
Test candidate leading signals against later observed outcomes using known-at dates and independent evidence; do not claim a universal predictive score.

eia860m_xlsx_download.status_warning: Operating sheet contains OP and SB etc. Filter original Status explicitly; Operating sheet membership alone is not evidence of current dispatch/AI use. DC Net Capacity (MW) means direct-current capacity, not data-center power.

missing_public_resolutions: Global current customer-level chip orders/lead times and HBM/advanced-packaging yield are not fully public.
No universal customer-level DC power queue, metered AI-only MWh or enterprise AI paid-demand API was established.
Resource statistics are annual/aggregate and some material/code distinctions remain unavailable.
ETF historical shares/NAV coverage and corporate actions must be established before allocation/flow history is calculated.
validation_plan: Freeze metric definitions and units before comparing changes; missing/suppressed/censored are separate from zero.
Retain event date, measurement period, target date, publication/filed time and retrieval time; only information published by a historical cutoff may enter that signal.
Validate company/project/contract mappings against source IDs and effective dates. Unknown counterparties remain unknown.
Compare matched cohorts with the same capacity basis. No ratio between unrelated staged aggregate snapshots.
Deduplicate joint press releases and shared model inputs. Separate investments, purchases, financing and actual receipts within one economic commitment.
Define an outcome before testing: later paid purchase, shipment, equipment acceptance, actual load or realized cash. Each outcome has a different unit and horizon.

Evaluate candidate leads using available historical vintages and out-of-time projects, preserving cancellations, right-censoring, unavailable data and source coverage changes. No asserted lead months or invented thresholds.
Record failures/429/revisions and coverage. A successful small public sample establishes that route only, not full market coverage or maximum free quotas.

publication_context.boundary: Research intake only. Apply the existing evidence and human-review contracts before empirical use. A source link or source review is not evidence approval.
